solutionSql:
SELECT s.id,
       s.tracking_code
FROM shipments s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipment_events e
  WHERE e.shipment_id = s.id
)
ORDER BY s.id;
notes: Twenty-two shipments have no events, mostly on a regular id pattern (1, 12, 23, and so on). NOT EXISTS is used, so the answer does not depend on NULL handling.
